plugin_desc: Sixnet SLX industrial Ethernet switch SNMP collection (IANA PEN 20540). Interface traffic is supplied by the shared Switch SNMP IF-MIB floor. Proven private device-health objects are P1/P2 power-input status and OK alarm-relay status (off/on/unknown). Optional serial number and firmware revision are collected as instance tags when the device returns them. CPU and memory utilization are not collected because no private CPU or memory utilization scalar is published. Supported brands/models — Sixnet SLX/SL SlimLine industrial Ethernet switches.
name: Switch

metrics.name: psu1_status
metrics.description: Operational state of Sixnet P1 power input. Native codes are off (0), on (1), and unknown (2). A value other than 1 means the primary power input is lost or the state cannot be determined.

metrics.name: psu2_status
metrics.description: Operational state of Sixnet P2 power input. Native codes are off (0), on (1), and unknown (2). A value other than 1 means the redundant power input is lost or the state cannot be determined.

metrics.name: ok_relay_status
metrics.description: Operational state of the Sixnet OK alarm relay. Native codes are off (0), on (1), and unknown (2). on means the relay is on the OK side; off or unknown means an alarm condition or an undetermined relay state.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
